summary: Frontend-only review of Crowned fan landing page. Verified hero, scroll-driven window film with 5 chapters (certificate, checkout, limits, gifter-test, reviews), edge-to-edge window at intro end (1920x1080 bounding box), window URL pill updates per chapter, left nav highlights, chapter rail stays in sync, glass caption shows 01/05..05/05 label + heading, fake cursor appears on desktop. Animated values verified: checkout totals animate $26->$27.50->$33->$55 as chip changes, limits bars fill (622/466 px), gifter-test %: 82/66/74/90, reviews ring reaches $100. Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow, mobile-bar at y=763 while caption bottom at y=595 (no overlap), mobile-cta visible. Marquee, HowItWorks, FAQ (all 4 items expand), closing CTA, footer all render and work. Theme is fully monochrome. Fixed one critical pageerror in FakeCursor on chapter transitions.

ui_bugs.issue: On chapter transition, stale step index exceeds new steps array -> runtime TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'x'). Fixed in this iteration with fallback to steps[0] + null guard.

issues: data-testid is 'closing' on section but task spec mentioned 'closing-cta' (which is present on the button). Minor spec mismatch - the CTA button has correct testid.

action_items: Review the FakeCursor fix in /app/frontend/src/components/Hero.jsx (lines 309-311). Consider resetting `step` state synchronously with screenId change via a derived state pattern instead of useEffect to avoid the fallback altogether.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero.jsx FakeCursor: useEffect resets step on screenId change but React renders with stale step first, causing out-of-bounds access. Current fix uses fallback; a cleaner approach is keyed remount (<FakeCursor key={screenId}/>) so the component re-initializes with fresh state.
Scroll film uses fixed thresholds (INTRO_END, CHAPTER constants). Works correctly but any change to screens array length will desync chapter mapping.
Checkout animated price overshoots observed values ($26.04 while chip is $25) due to spring overshoot on useAmount animation - purely cosmetic.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No backend. Film section is 7560px tall (700vh) at 1920x1080; film_top=76, scroll_range=6480. Chapter mid-points: p = 0.24 + 0.148*(i+0.5). Use wait_until='domcontentloaded' + explicit wait (not networkidle) because framer-motion keeps network busy-ish. Caption glass at bottom of window; on mobile it moves above the mobile-bar (bottom:88px).
